description: This file defines the ListsAdminNodeDriver class, a display driver for managing ListAdminNode objects within OrchardCore, including display, editing, and updating logic, as well as helper methods for content type validation and selection.

classes.name: ListsAdminNodeDriver
classes.description: A display driver class for managing ListsAdminNode objects, providing display, edit, and update functionalities within OrchardCore.

methods.name: DisplayAsync
methods.description: Generates display views for a ListsAdminNode, including a summary and thumbnail.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Prepares the editing view model for a ListsAdminNode.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Handles the update process for a ListsAdminNode, validating input and updating properties.

methods.name: GetContentTypesSelectListAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a list of content types that include the ListPart, formatted for selection.

methods.name: IsValidContentTypeAsync
methods.description: Checks if a given content type includes the ListPart, validating its suitability.
